name: Community demo: write and verify
description: An agent creates one greeting file in a fresh demo workspace, then a read-only peer verifies it.

steps.name: Create the greeting
steps.promptTemplate:
This is a tiny community demonstration in a dedicated empty workspace. Create hello.txt in the working directory with exactly this one line: Hello, Conduit community!
Do not edit any other file. Reply with one short sentence confirming what you wrote.

steps.name: Read-only verification
steps.promptTemplate: Read hello.txt from the working directory without editing files. Reply with VERIFIED followed by its exact one-line content if it contains Hello, Conduit community! Otherwise reply MISMATCH and briefly explain. The previous agent reported: {{previous_output}}
